description.narrative: Carbon Value Exchange Ltd (“CaVEx”), is a UK domiciled company seeking to use digital technology to drive end to end integrity for voluntary carbon markets in the Global South. CaVEx will enable micro and small-scale carbon projects (last mile participants) access climate finance through market access to global carbon credit buyers via a digital market and payments platform.

participating-org.narrative: UK - Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office

activity-date.narrative: This is the date the investment was made.

recipient-country.narrative: Carbon Value Exchange Ltd, is a private company limited by shares registered in England and Wales.

recipient-region.narrative: Projects supplying carbon credits will be based in the global south (Africa, Latin America and Southeast Asia) whilst buyers will be global. Initial use case development is mainly focused on Africa.

sector.narrative: Projects engaged in carbon mitigation and removal activities will supply their carbon credits directly through the CaVEx platform. Edge intelligence will be used to remotely capture real time data on project micro activity. The activity based data will thereafter be used to create accurate digital carbon credits. Initial project use cases include clean cook stoves, solar water pumps, forestry, electric bikes, waste to energy biogas and solar battery chargers.
